1.w: And Abram went up from Egypt, he and his wife and all that he had—and Lot with him—to the Negev.

2.w: And Abram [was] very rich in the livestock, in the silver, and in the gold.

3.w: And he went on his journey from the Negev, and even to Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning between Bethel and between Ai,

4.w: to the place of the altar that he had made there at the first. And there Abram called on the name of YHWH.

5.w: And also Lot, who went with Abram, had a flock and a herd, and tents.

6.w: And the land was not able to support them to dwell together, for their possessions were great, and they were not able to dwell together.

7.w: And there was strife between the shepherds of livestock of Abram and between the shepherds of livestock of Lot. And the Canaanite and the Perizzite were then dwelling in the land.

8.w: And Abram said to Lot, “Please let there not be strife between me and between you, and between my shepherds and between your shepherds, for we [are] men—brothers.

9.w: Is not all the land before you? Separate, please, from me—if to the left, then I will go to the right; and if to the right, then I will go to the left.”

10.w: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and he saw all the plain of the Jordan, for all of it [was] well watered (before YHWH destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah) like the garden of YHWH, like the land of Egypt, as you go toward Zoar.

11.w: And Lot chose for himself all the plain of the Jordan, and Lot journeyed toward the east. And they separated, a man from his brother.

12.w: Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelt in the cities of the plain, and he pitched [his] tent toward Sodom.

13.w: And the men of Sodom [were] wicked and exceedingly sinful before YHWH.

14.w: And YHWH said to Abram after Lot had separated from him, “Lift up now your eyes and look from the place where you [are]—northward and southward and eastward and westward.

15.w: For all the land that you are seeing, I give to you and to your seed unto eternity.

16.w: And I will make your seed as the dust of the earth, so that if a man is able to number the dust of the earth, [then] also your seed could be numbered.

17.w: Arise, walk in the land through its length and its width, for to you I give it.”

18.w: And Abram moved [his] tent, and he went and dwelt by the Oaks of Mamre which [are] in Hebron, and he built there an altar to YHWH.
